candidates.review_note: Only pairs with both endpoints on the rectangle boundary can separate other paths. In perimeter order these pairs must be nested or disjoint, checked by a stack; interior endpoints can be routed without creating a separating chord.

Production and sale month capacities form a bipartite min-cost flow network. Allowed edges respect each lot shelf life and include storage cost; augment only while a residual route increases total profit.

Enumerate cell subsets containing every village. A valid simple orthogonal enclosure requires one connected interior and no exterior hole; bitset flood fills check both without reading image-only details.

Any feasible row is a multiple of all requested gcd values; its least possible choice is their lcm. Generalized CRT finds the required column residues, and exact gcd rechecks reject excessive common factors before accepting the bounded position.

An element contributes whenever a size-k subset contains it but does not make it the minimum or maximum. Subtract the two extreme binomial counts; compute the binomial column exactly before reducing exponents modulo p-1, avoiding invalid inverses modulo a composite.

Future observations impose a lower bound on present mark counts because at most one new mark is added per day. Propagate those bounds backward, enforce nondecreasing counts forward, and sum marks below as total minus above minus one.

Over a binary alphabet a length-at-least-two substring is bad exactly when it has two runs and one end run is a singleton. Each adjacent run pair contributes left_length+right_length-1 such substrings, subtracting the double-counted length-two case.
Known rounds partition the unknown identifiers into independent runs. Each run can be all single Div2 rounds for the maximum or adjacent Div2/Div1 pairs plus an optional singleton for the minimum.
